data_dict.NL_V2: The vertex c has an edge to the vertex e.

data_dict.CNL_V2: A inn is identified by a value, by an id. A vertex is identified by an id. A no_inn is identified by a value, by an id. Whenever there is a inn with value V, with id V1 different from V2, whenever there is a vertex with id V2 then we must have a no_inn with value V, with id V2.
data_dict.NL_V2: When an inn is linked to one value and an id that is distinct from a second id, and a vertex with this second id exists, then there have a no_inn with the initial value and the second id.

data_dict.CNL_V2: A init is identified by an vertex. A inn is identified by a value, by an id. A reached is identified by an vertex. Whenever there is a init with vertex V1, whenever there is a inn with value V1, with id V2 then we must have a reached with vertex V2.
data_dict.NL_V2: Whenever there is an init with a specific vertex and an inn associated with that vertex and a second vertex, then a reached must be established with the second vertex.

data_dict.CNL_V2: A reached is identified by an id. An inn is identified by a value, by an id. Whenever there is a reached with id V1, whenever there is a inn with value V1, with id V2 then we must have a reached with id V2.
data_dict.NL_V2: Whenever there is an reached with a specific vertex and an inn associated with that vertex and a second vertex, then a reached must be established with the second vertex.

data_dict.CNL_V2: An edge is identified by a node1, by a node2. Every edge can be cubic.
data_dict.NL_V2: Choose the edges forming the cubic graph.

data_dict.CNL_V2: A node is identified by an id, and by a weight. A set is identified by an id. Whenever there is a node N, then N can be assigned to exactly 1 set.
data_dict.NL_V2: Each weighted node must be assigned to exactly one of the available sets.

data_dict.CNL_V2: A node is identified by an id, and by a weight. A set is identified by an id. A assigned is identified by node, and by a set. Whenever there is a node then we can have exactly 1 assigned with node id N, with node weight W, with set id S such that there is a set with id S.
data_dict.NL_V2: Nodes and its weights should be assigned to one of the given sets.

data_dict.CNL_V2: A shift is identified by an id. A nurse is identified by an id. A day is identified by an id. Every nurse can work in exactly 1 shift for each day.
data_dict.NL_V2: Nurses can work in exactly one shift per day.

data_dict.CNL_V2: A shift is identified by an id. A nurse is identified by an id. A day is identified by an id. An allocated is identified by a nurse, by a day, and by a shift. Whenever there is a day with id D, whenever there is a nurse with id N then we can have exactly 1 allocated with nurse id N, with day id D, with shift id S such that there is a shift with id S.
data_dict.NL_V2: Choose one shift in which to allocate a nurse per day.
